content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I'm looking for assistance. Does anyone have a program example with an encoder that can automatically detect if the position is increasing or decreasing, without requiring an external input pulse to indicate the counter direction?
Please do not post the same question multiple times for a single issue. You have already submitted this on 06/05/2024.
This thread has been closed due to duplicate posts. The second topic on encoder was published in the [product_name] - Projects conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is requesting guidance and resources on how to implement automatic direction detection with an encoder on a [product_name] module, specifically aiming to avoid the need for manual digital input triggering. No technical solution was provided because the thread was closed for duplicate posting rather than addressing the original inquiry.
